project.ghostAssetsTitle: Some assets could not be loaded
project.ghostAssetsBody: {n, plural, one{1 asset has no file on disk and no embedded copy - it shows as a red placeholder. Relink it here or from the Outliner (right-click > Relink), or delete it. The project can still be saved.} other{# assets have no file on disk and no embedded copy - they show as red placeholders.
